summary.text: Stephanie Hilferty is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 94 (Jefferson and Orleans parishes), and was elected in 2015, according to the official House member page. Stephanie Hilferty chairs the House Committee on Enrollment.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Stephanie Hilferty's occupation as Commercial Real Estate Agent.
It lists education as St. Mary's Dominican High School; B.A., Loyola University New Orleans.

The page lists committee assignments including Commerce, the House Committee on Enrollment (chair) and the House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus affiliations including the Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Orleans Delegation.
